findings.claim: The proposed empty-field precedence does not work for the plan's own example. With the proposed greedy grammar, checked=; evidence=... captures ';' as the checked value; whitespace trimming leaves it non-empty, and the unchanged punctuation-normalizing blacklist then converts it to an empty string and reports a tautology instead of a shape failure.
findings.evidence: Section 1.1 says captures are trimmed and explicitly claims a capture containing only ';' trims to empty. The existing bash implementation trims only whitespace before applying a second normalization that strips punctuation, while the proposed Node flow likewise describes trim before blacklist normalization. Therefore the stated shape-before-blacklist check cannot classify this case as shape.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN_UNDER_REVIEW §1 ruling 1; scripts/dispatch-review.sh proof_checked/proof_normalized handling; src/runners/review.js isValidNoFindingProof normalization
findings.repair: Define an explicit pre-blacklist shape test that requires each capture to contain at least one character outside the allowed separator set after separator-edge removal, implement it identically in bash and Node, and pin checked=; evidence=... plus the corresponding empty evidence and conclusion cases as shape failures in the shared vectors.

findings.claim: The plan specifies two incompatible sources for finalPanelSeatReceipt.raw_log: the ruling requires reading outcome.raw_log and explicitly forbids reading a nested dispatch path, while the file-level instructions direct finalPanelSeatReceipt to inspect the outcome's raw dispatch result for salvaged.raw_log.
findings.evidence: Section 1.3 says the seat receipt reads the top-level outcome.raw_log and never a nested raw dispatch path. Section 2's autopilot-engine.js bullet instead says finalPanelSeatReceipt adds raw_log when the outcome's raw dispatch result has salvaged.raw_log. Existing performReview wraps the engine review as outcome.raw, so these instructions lead to different implementations and can bypass the required R4 top-level propagation seam.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN_UNDER_REVIEW §1 ruling 3 and §2 src/engine/autopilot-engine.js bullet; src/engine/autopilot-engine.js performReview and finalPanelSeatReceipt
findings.repair: Make every implementation instruction require finalPanelSeatReceipt to consume only outcome.raw_log. Keep nested salvage inspection confined to the earlier engine-to-performReview propagation step, and add a test proving the receipt is populated from the top-level field rather than a nested dispatch object.

findings.affected_surface: Release metadata and sealed output scope
findings.claim: The plan requires documentation to claim that the work shipped in v2.36.57 while forbidding every canonical version and changelog file from the exact output scope, leaving the repository version at v2.36.56 and making the shipped-version claim false.
findings.evidence: Base 0e3ea3cc declares version 2.36.56 in .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Section 2 requires BACKLOG and the l5 reference to say v2.36.57, explicitly says CHANGELOG.md is not sealed, and §2.5 omits all version manifests, marketplace mirrors, README version mirrors, and CHANGELOG.md. The scope-integrity acceptance criterion would reject a normal synchronized version bump.
findings.evidence_reference: PLAN_UNDER_REVIEW §2 Docs, §2.5, and §4 scope-integrity; base 0e3ea3cc .claude-plugin/plugin.json; AGENTS.md Build version-bump policy
findings.repair: Expand §2.5 and scope-integrity allowances to include every file produced by the repository's canonical v2.36.57 version synchronization plus CHANGELOG.md, and add node scripts/sync-version.js --check to acceptance. Preserve the R10 documentation wording only after those release artifacts are updated consistently.
